1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

This petition has been filed challenging the Public Notice dated 31st July, 2025 issued under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 ('Act of 2013'), in respect to the land described in the prayer clause.

6. Notices are accepted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel who appears for respondent nos.1 & 2 and Ms. Shobhana Takiar, Advocate who appears for Delhi Development Authority (DDA).
7. Issue notice to the remaining respondent, returnable on 22nd September 2025.
